JTBD - **Critical for DITAMAP creation**
Usage: 
- Use this tab to map content for a job, into smaller jobs or topics for a category. This captures the state of the job after you are done with the JTBD work for the job.
- Create copies for each new job as needed for your use case. 
- You can also use one tab to add all your Jobs if you have small doc set.
Important: 
- You must ensure that the Job outline is added as per the format in this tab. This tab will be used by the migration team to create DITAMAPs for your Job/Category.
- Ensure that each nested heading is entered on the row after the parent heading. This ensures that you can provide the corresponding nav titles and .adoc file names.
- Ensure that all .adoc file names have been added when you submit this sheet to the CA team for DITA migration. For example: "...assembly-importing-your-team-codebase-from-git.adoc" or  "proc-techdocs-find-docs.adoc". Parent topics 
Tip:
You can:
- Copy and use the 'Before and after job map template' as a worksheet to compare the before (with d.r.c links) and afters (with .adoc file links) for your jobs; interact with stakeholders; and finalize your job outline before you enter the details into this tab. 
- Split the before and after tables into separate tabs or modify your copies as needed for your work.
